manifest.schema: CREATE TABLE manifest (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)

master_drug.schema:
CREATE TABLE master_drug (
    drugbank_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name             TEXT,
    cas_number       TEXT,
    unii             TEXT,
    type             TEXT,
    state            TEXT,
    inchikey         TEXT,
    smiles           TEXT,
    molecular_formula TEXT,
    molecular_weight REAL,
    -- calculated (DrugBank, predicted)
    logp REAL, logs REAL,
    pka_strongest_acidic REAL, pka_strongest_basic REAL,
    polar_surface_area REAL,
    h_bond_donor_count INTEGER, h_bond_acceptor_count INTEGER,
    rotatable_bond_count INTEGER,
    -- in-vivo (DrugBank curated text)
    absorption TEXT, half_life TEXT, protein_binding TEXT,
    route_of_elimination TEXT, volume_of_distribution TEXT, clearance TEXT,
    -- experimental (solid-state / solubility, with literature source)
    exp_melting_point TEXT,
    exp_water_solubility TEXT, exp_water_solubility_source TEXT,
    exp_isoelectric_point TEXT,
    -- classification
    superclass TEXT, class TEXT,
    -- pipeline metadata
    source_version TEXT,
    built_at TEXT
)

x_chembl.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_chembl (
            drugbank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            chembl_id TEXT, chembl_name TEXT, match_type TEXT,
            first_approval TEXT, bcs_class TEXT,
            alogp REAL, psa REAL, hbd INTEGER, hba INTEGER, rtb INTEGER,
            oral INTEGER, parenteral INTEGER, topical INTEGER, black_box INTEGER
        )

x_confidence.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_confidence (
            drugbank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT,
            mw_n INTEGER, mw_agree INTEGER, mw_tier TEXT,
            logp_n INTEGER, logp_agree INTEGER, logp_tier TEXT,
            psa_n INTEGER, psa_agree INTEGER, psa_tier TEXT,
            overall_tier TEXT
        )

x_coverage.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_coverage (
            layer TEXT, field TEXT, source TEXT,
            drugs_with_field INTEGER, pct_of_spine REAL
        )

x_exp_crosscheck.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_exp_crosscheck (
            drugbank_id TEXT, name TEXT, field TEXT,
            drugbank_value TEXT, drugbank_lo REAL, drugbank_hi REAL, drugbank_unit_known INTEGER,
            pubchem_value TEXT, pubchem_lo REAL, pubchem_hi REAL,
            relation TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (drugbank_id, field)
        )

x_groups.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_groups (
            drugbank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT,
            groups_verbatim TEXT,        -- 官方 XML 原文,逐字保留(顿号连接)
            is_approved INTEGER, is_investigational INTEGER,
            is_experimental INTEGER, is_withdrawn INTEGER,
            is_illicit INTEGER, is_nutraceutical INTEGER,
            is_veterinary INTEGER
        )

x_in_vivo.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_in_vivo (
            drugbank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT,
            -- half-life, normalised to hours (min..max interval)
            half_life_h_min REAL, half_life_h_max REAL, half_life_raw TEXT,
            -- protein binding, percent; qualitative=1 for 'negligibly bound'
            protein_binding_pct REAL, protein_binding_qualitative INTEGER,
            protein_binding_raw TEXT,
            -- volume of distribution, as-stated unit
            vd_value REAL, vd_unit TEXT, vd_raw TEXT,
            -- clearance, as-stated unit (interval or point)
            clearance_min REAL, clearance_max REAL, clearance_unit TEXT,
            clearance_raw TEXT,
            extracted_fields INTEGER
        )

x_logp_analysis.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_logp_analysis (
            drugbank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT,
            db_logp REAL, chembl_alogp REAL, pubchem_xlogp REAL,
            db_minus_chembl REAL, db_minus_pubchem REAL, chembl_minus_pubchem REAL
        )

x_nmpa.schema:
CREATE TABLE "x_nmpa"(
  drugbank_id TEXT,
  match_name TEXT,
  match_type TEXT,
  n_cn_references INT,
  n_originator INT,
  sample_holder TEXT,
  latest_batch TEXT
)

x_orange_book.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_orange_book (
            drugbank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            match_name TEXT, match_type TEXT,
            n_products INTEGER, n_rld INTEGER, n_rs INTEGER,
            n_patents INTEGER, n_exclusivity INTEGER,
            sample_trade_name TEXT, sample_appl_no TEXT
        )

x_pubchem.schema:
CREATE TABLE x_pubchem (
            drugbank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            match_name TEXT, match_type TEXT,
            pubchem_cid TEXT,
            molecular_weight REAL, xlogp REAL, tpsa REAL,
            hbd INTEGER, hba INTEGER,
            molecular_formula TEXT
        )
